# Wan2Animate

> > AI-powered character animation and video generation platform featuring Wan 2.2 Animate for character replacement, motion transfer, and portrait animation.

Wan2Animate provides advanced AI video generation tools specializing in character animation, motion imitation, and role-play modes. The platform offers multiple AI models including Wan Animate, Wan 2.2 Animate Move/Mix variants, and integration with Sora2 for text-to-video and image-to-video generation.

## Key Topics

- Wan 2.2 Animate
- Wan Animate
- Character Animation
- Motion Transfer
- Motion Imitation
- Character Replacement
- AI Video Generator
- Portrait Animation
- Role-Play Mode
- Wan-animate-move
- Wan-animate-mix
- Sora2
- Text-to-Video
- Image-to-Video
- AI Avatar

## Core AI Video Generation Tools

- [Wan2.2 Animate | Character Replacement Video Generator](https://wan2animate.com): Main platform homepage featuring Wan2.2 Animate character replacement and animation capabilities
- [Wan Animate | Character Animation AI Video Generator](https://wan2animate.com/wan-animate): Core AI model for character animation with advanced motion transfer and imitation features
- [Sora2 | AI Video Generator - Free](https://wan2animate.com/sora-2): Free text-to-video and image-to-video AI generation tool powered by Sora2 technology
